purpose: Approved unornamented left-profile item in the four-direction full-body baseline.

pipeline.pose_control: prompt-only strict left profile; no Canny, OpenPose, depth, or other structure input

approved_review: strict left-facing nose, eyes, chin, gaze, shoulders, torso, hips, knees, and toes
one full body with two coherent legs and planted feet
teal bob with no visible hair clip, pin, ornament, or metallic shape
continuous fringe with no exposed scalp part or hairline gap
white jacket, teal trousers, and white sneakers
no bag and no shoulder strap
no crop, frame, text, or watermark
